# Pangea Stanford

> > Pangea Stanford provides computing resources and support documentation for Stanford University researchers and students.

Pangea Stanford is a computing platform serving the Stanford community. This documentation site helps new users get started with computing resources and find support when needed.

## Key Topics

- Stanford Computing
- New Users
- Support Resources
- Getting Help
- Documentation
- Pangea Platform

## Getting Started & Support

- [Get help if you need it](https://pangea.stanford.edu/computing/newusers/help.php): Support resources and help guide for new Pangea Stanford computing users
